scope: D04 personal VM local checkpoints; isolated diagnostic mounting, not formal authenticated release
implemented: Unencrypted account/origin/environment-scoped IndexedDB checkpoints; temporary environments refused
Atomic head+state transaction, compare-and-swap revisions, retain newest two complete generations, quota preflight and 512 MiB cap
Digest and fixed engine/image/profile compatibility checked before persistence and restore; no silent old-version fallback
Persistent deletion tombstone and abort/owner-disposal guards; explicit cleanup receipt required
Manual save, save-and-stop, explicit restore, 5-minute personal autosave; no command replay and restore disconnects existing network
Worker checkpoint transport; pause/capture/resume and fatal cleanup on resume failure; streamed download lease prevents snapshots
Isolated diagnostic page exposes save/restore/status and unencrypted storage warnings

checkpointStore.includes: aborted active transaction, corrupt persisted bytes, quota, CAS, tombstones, isolation

runtimeCheckpoint.includes: autosave, cancellation, fresh-instance overwrite refusal, save-and-stop

nativeBrowser.scope: One diagnostic browser happy path; not full browser matrix, quota/crash or authenticated acceptance

verification.cleanup: Diagnostic VM stopped, agent-created tab closed, local probe server stopped; interrupted-test generated directory removed

limitations: Unencrypted snapshots can include guest credentials or other private data. Account partitioning is not protection from same-origin code or device access. No cloud backup or persistence guarantee against browser eviction.
Only fixed RAM-root + in-memory-9p + readonly-ISO development profile; arbitrary writable external disks are unsupported.
Production signed image/manifest and formal authenticated UI mounting remain G0-gated.
Formal deletion-reconciler wiring, cross-tab/account metadata revalidation and complete browser crash/quota/revocation matrix remain pending.
Retained previous version has a store-level explicit load API; no recovery-selection UI yet.
No permission changes, external network/GitHub retry, APK reinstall or production operations.
next: Complete local VM cleanup/reconciliation and recovery controls; preserve G0 gate for formal authenticated mounting.
